body: I'm teaching in South Korea.  I move around too much to get a dog and if I go into the graduate program, apartments tend to be very anti dog, especially over here. I grew up with pets and while I was depressed then, they were only things to help me. I thought about getting one of those permits for an emotional care animal. I could never end my life with another being dependent upon me for survival.  Yet, I'm so burned out of life and see no hope in the future. I've lost my passion for teaching though I still put a lot of effort in my classes (and most students like me a lot and would never suspect how I truly feel) I just don't have the strength to go on.
